requirements: Claude Code on Windows, Mac or Linux; the first run installs its free tools (Python, FFmpeg, a local Kokoro voice). ElevenLabs is optional.

preview.description: A 60-90 second second-person survival thriller: real 3D low-poly sets with flat 2D stickmen acting inside them, rules, a twist and a two-choice ending, narrated with captions and sound.

video.caption: Example by Theo, made with this guide.
